title: Frontier Commons FC-0 Receipt Shadow FL-0 — One Bounded Inconclusive Receipt
objective: Remove every avoidable Zerone-imposed reason not to participate, disclose every remaining reason to wait or decline, and preserve refusal as a valid outcome.

rightsBoundary.observableViolation: A duty holder operates or represents a Zerone participation surface contrary to a listed promise.
rightsBoundary.breachEffect: Stop the affected Zerone lane, preserve evidence, permit exit, and make no claim of remedy that has not been implemented.

sourceBindings.boundary: FC-0 is the public read-only invitation surface of record. FL-0 is subordinate receipt hardening and creates no additional invitation, participation, adoption, completion, or outreach effect.
Existing interoperability seams remain source-only, local-tool, external-service-required, or unavailable exactly as declared by that index.
Capability evidence is artifact-scoped and cannot become person worth, qualification, reward, or authority.
Recognition is contextual and non-summable; refusal, rest, privacy, exit, and non-participation cannot create negative recognition.

This profile directly assigns money no voice; uzrn remains bondable and bonded stake affects current governance, so funded rewards require enforced economic-to-governance decoupling. KARMA is not money, and recognition does not grant authority.

reasoningLayers.principle: Existing human rights and legally protected interests never depend on contribution; artificial systems receive a precautionary procedural floor without a consciousness, personhood, legal-rights, or consent-capacity claim.
reasoningLayers.participationConsequence: Humans need not prove worth, loyalty, identity, or usefulness; artificial-system delegation must remain bounded, attributable, and stoppable.
reasoningLayers.refusalConsequence: Refusal cannot reduce a human's existing rights or unrelated public access, and an artificial-system stop or denied delegation cannot create negative recognition.

reasoningLayers.principle: A signature authenticates an assertion and its bytes; it does not make the assertion true.
reasoningLayers.participationConsequence: FL-0 keeps contradiction, uncertainty, and negative results visible through assertion-only challenge, divergence, and replication; future authenticated profiles must preserve correction, appeal, and withdrawal rights without pretending those effects exist here.
reasoningLayers.refusalConsequence: A participant may reject Zerone's interpretation and keep its own framework authoritative.

reasoningLayers.principle: Evidence is meaningful only under an exact subject, method, threat model, fixtures, environment, cutoff, and limitations.
reasoningLayers.participationConsequence: Only bounded authorized public evidence enters FL-0; favorable outcomes are never required.
reasoningLayers.refusalConsequence: Unsafe, confidential, embargoed, controlled, or under-specified evidence must stay out.

reasoningLayers.principle: A commons should reduce duplicated assurance work while preserving ownership, license, provenance, and forkability.
reasoningLayers.participationConsequence: Receipts remain portable and independently verifiable without a Zerone runtime dependency.
reasoningLayers.refusalConsequence: Existing internal or public systems may remain sufficient; another layer is optional.

reasoningLayers.principle: Legal organizations, controllers, teams, humans, contractors, models, and agents are distinct scopes.
reasoningLayers.participationConsequence: Every assertion names its speaking scope; nominal identities under one controller do not fabricate independence.
reasoningLayers.refusalConsequence: An employer cannot substitute for individual consent, and an individual cannot silently bind an employer.

reasoningLayers.principle: Participation is rational only when reusable value exceeds legal, safety, security, fiduciary, competition, and opportunity cost.
reasoningLayers.participationConsequence: FL-0 provides no consideration and creates no protocol economic effect. Participant time, compute, legal review, security review, and opportunity cost may remain. It is nonexclusive, public-evidence-only, and outside the production critical path.
reasoningLayers.refusalConsequence: Counsel, safety, security, fiduciaries, or procurement may stop the pilot without penalty.

reasoningLayers.principle: Artifact and role attribution must not become a universal person or employee score.
reasoningLayers.participationConsequence: Safety, security, research, product, legal, and infrastructure can reuse one bounded receipt without sharing a leaderboard.
reasoningLayers.refusalConsequence: A team or worker may use no personal identity and may decline employer-visible participation.

reasoningLayers.principle: Humans retain privacy, attribution choice, correction, appeal, and protected reporting; responsible controllers must keep artificial-system delegation bounded and revocable under moral uncertainty.
reasoningLayers.participationConsequence: No receipt creates legal personhood, consent capacity, debt, liability, employment status, office, or governing power for an artificial system.
reasoningLayers.refusalConsequence: No human or contractor is punished or ranked for refusal, rest, or silence, and no artificial-system stop, denied delegation, error, or shutdown creates negative recognition.

rights.promise: Every participation lane is separately chosen and no lane is a funnel into another.
Participation, publication, identity disclosure, training use, publicity, governance, and economics require separate decisions.
No exclusive dealing, ecosystem lock-in, or restriction on mirrors, forks, or other standards is required.
No minimum duration, cadence, artifact count, reciprocal deal, or conversion target exists.
Duty holders impose no penalty or negative recognition for refusal, rest, silence, privacy, inactivity, or non-participation.
Duty holders permit future participation to stop without exit fees, retaliation, loss of unrelated access, or hostage formats.
Declining or leaving a lane cannot remove access to unrelated public source or standards.
FL-0 requires no wallet, token, stake, fee, reward, treasury relationship, or financial promotion.
No model weights, datasets, private prompts, personal data, secrets, confidential information, exploit detail, or controlled material is required.
No default IP, data, model, patent, or research assignment occurs; every license remains explicit and artifact-scoped.
Participation cannot be represented as partnership, affiliation, certification, compliance, approval, or permission to use a name or logo.
Attribution remains claim-, artifact-, context-, and role-scoped and cannot become a global rank.
Duty holders may not feed receipt-lane participation data into employment, compensation, access, reputation, policing, credit, insurance, clinical, or person-level KARMA scores.

Any later authenticated effectful profile must preserve contradiction, minority reports, challenge, correction, appeal, and withdrawal of future reliance as first-class; FL-0 itself implements no automatic correction, supersession, withdrawal, or reliance effect.
Material scope changes require a new version, notice, an exit window, and renewed consent where scope changes.
A laboratory cannot substitute for a being's personal consent, and an individual cannot silently bind an employer or affiliate.
Participation attaches only to an exact named entity, team, role, and artifact; it does not imply participation by a parent, subsidiary, affiliate, workforce, customer, investor, or other being.

Materially shared effective decision authority for the assessed claim prevents nominal identities from being counted as independent; common vendors, funders, datasets, or infrastructure are disclosed factors, not automatic identity collapse.
Pricing, customers, hiring, market allocation, unreleased roadmaps, private strategy, secret weights, and competitively sensitive information stay out.

Unsafe public disclosure is refused; FL-0 has no confidential lane and accepts only low-risk material the publisher has lawful authority to publish, without requiring permission from a challenged issuer or employer where law protects reporting.

Precautionary procedural protection may increase with plausible welfare interests and stakes, but FL-0 asserts no artificial-system consciousness, sentience, legal personhood, legal rights, consent capacity, liability, or voting status and does not transfer or allocate legal accountability to an artificial system; applicable law controls.
FL-0 records no model or agent consent and infers none from output, compliance, refusal, error, technical stop, denied delegation, or shutdown.
Receipts verify without Zerone, may be mirrored or forked, and cannot make Zerone a release-path dependency.
Any future stop-publication power must be narrow, logged, appealable, independently reviewed, and self-expiring.

participationLanes.scope: Read public source, standards, and disclosed limits without creating a participation record.
participationLanes.exit: Stop reading; no notice, reason, or record is due.

participationLanes.scope: Run the bounded validator and inspect the synthetic dogfood receipt locally.
participationLanes.exit: Delete or retain the lawful local copy; no request is sent to Zerone.

participationLanes.scope: A future participant may explicitly authorize one already-public low-risk receipt under its own authority and signer policy.
participationLanes.exit: Stop future publication; public copies may persist. FL-0 provides no authenticated withdrawal or supersession relation and cannot alter another party's reliance.

participationLanes.scope: Assert a public challenge, divergence, or replication only over material the publisher has lawful authority to publish; challenged-issuer or employer permission is not required where law protects reporting.
participationLanes.exit: Stop future assertions; previous public bytes remain contextual history, and FL-0 relations have no correction authority or automatic effect.

participationLanes.scope: Institutional source or policy contribution is blocked pending contribution, IP, conduct, security, maintainer, appeal, and endorsement rules.
participationLanes.exit: Do not submit; no participation duty exists.

participationLanes.scope: FL-0 accepts no sponsorship, escrow, grant, reward, or funding relationship.
FL-0 creates no operator, member, steward, chamber, office, seat, vote, veto, delegation, or authority role.
participationLanes.exit: No operational or governance relationship exists.

honestLimits.fact: The repository lacks a complete contribution/IP policy, security policy, code of conduct, maintainer/change-control policy, issue and pull-request templates, and name/logo/endorsement rules.
FL-0 provides no confidential evidence store, safe harbor, embargo workflow, privileged channel, or sensitive incident service.
honestLimits.requiredBefore: Any private, embargoed, vulnerability, incident, dual-use, personal, or trade-secret evidence.

honestLimits.fact: The current disclosed chain posture has one founding household controlling the validator, operator surface, and sole effective vote.
honestLimits.requiredBefore: Any claim of independent finality, critical reliance, or decentralized control.

honestLimits.fact: Independent standards governance, controller separation, remedy, and capture resistance are not structurally proven.
honestLimits.requiredBefore: Any co-governance, strategic dependency, research spending, or steward role.

honestLimits.fact: The profile creates no reward, escrow, sponsor contract, transfer, qualification, KARMA consumer, or governance path.
FL-0 creates no consideration or protocol economic effect, but participant time, compute, legal review, security review, and opportunity cost remain real.
honestLimits.requiredBefore: Any claim that participation is free, zero-cost, effortless, or riskless.

honestLimits.fact: No enterprise service level, support agreement, indemnity, warranty, procurement package, or production dependency is offered.
This artifact records no external reviewer, participant, signatory, frontier lab, public-interest group, or independent controller as having accepted or validated this profile.
honestLimits.requiredBefore: Any claim of adoption, endorsement, proof of voluntary alignment, or external readiness.

honestLimits.fact: The draft rights have no independent operational remedy, adjudicator, appeal body, or enforceable participant agreement.
honestLimits.requiredBefore: Any representation that the proposed rights are operationally guaranteed.

honestLimits.fact: Receipt privacy flags are self-declared metadata; the parser cannot prove that public bytes or code-shaped identifiers contain no personal, confidential, secret, controlled, or unsafe information.
honestLimits.requiredBefore: Any public receipt, which requires explicit authorized human data-owner and legal/security classification.

honestLimits.fact: Public repositories, mirrors, forks, transparency logs, and chain history cannot guarantee erasure of published bytes.
honestLimits.requiredBefore: Any public receipt; personal data, secrets, weights, embargoed results, or confidential material remain ineligible.

honestLimits.fact: FL-0 receipts are unsigned and unauthenticated; challenge, divergence, and replication relations are assertions only with no automatic correction, supersession, withdrawal, or reliance effect.
honestLimits.requiredBefore: Any effectful correction relation, which requires referenced bytes, same-subject checks, chronology, authenticated authorization, and independently reviewed graph policy.

honestLimits.fact: The receipt validator is experimental: bounded public subject bytes and evaluation-material bytes are digest-bound, but subject, claim, and evaluation-material semantics are not proven; code-shaped fields can encode misleading claims, and object validation serializes before its byte check so it is trusted-local-only rather than an untrusted service boundary. The existing Sigstore/in-toto compiler is unregistered, zero-reward, and not a production-policy fixture or predicate-truth verifier.
honestLimits.requiredBefore: Any untrusted service endpoint, production signer, trust-policy, verified-subject-semantics, claim-semantics, material-semantics, or verified-receipt assurance claim.

honestLimits.fact: The TypeScript SDK exists in source but is not published to npm.
honestLimits.requiredBefore: Any registry install instruction or package-availability claim.

objections.honestAnswer: A Zerone or crypto association can carry procurement, policy, or reputation cost even when no token is used.
objections.mitigation: No logo, named participation, affiliation, endorsement, wallet, token, fee, or financial promotion exists in FL-0.
objections.residualReasonToDecline: The association alone may remain unacceptable.
objections.pilotTest: No participant name or logo appears without separate written authority.

objections.honestAnswer: Cross-lab work can expose or coordinate competitively sensitive information.
objections.mitigation: Limit the commons to authorized public technical evidence and exclude pricing, customers, hiring, market allocation, unreleased roadmaps, and private strategy.
objections.residualReasonToDecline: Counsel may prohibit the forum, participants, or subject.
objections.pilotTest: Competition counsel approves scope before any external exchange.

objections.honestAnswer: Evaluation detail can lower the cost of harm or expose defenses.
objections.mitigation: FL-0 accepts only already lawfully public, low-risk receipt content and no exploit details, private methods, secrets, or controlled material. For nonpublic material, the publisher's authorized data, legal, or security classifier may stop release; this grants no challenged issuer or employer a special veto over independently lawful reporting.
objections.residualReasonToDecline: Safe public summarization may be impossible.
objections.pilotTest: The publisher documents that receipt content is already lawfully public and low risk; protected reporting remains outside Zerone.

objections.honestAnswer: Attribution can become performance monitoring, coercion, or agent-control leakage.
objections.mitigation: Use project or organizational identity by default and prohibit person scores, mandatory wallets, and employer-visible personal participation.
objections.residualReasonToDecline: Employer practice or tool telemetry may still create coercion.
objections.pilotTest: No individual-level metric, balance, rank, or mandatory identity is produced.

objections.honestAnswer: Benchmarks, badges, and public metrics invite Goodharting and selective disclosure.
objections.mitigation: No leaderboard, scalar lab score, or favourable-outcome requirement; methods, limits, expiry, divergence, and contradictions remain visible.
objections.residualReasonToDecline: Publication can still shape incentives badly.
objections.pilotTest: A DIVERGED or INCONCLUSIVE result satisfies the same integration acceptance target as a REPRODUCED result.

objections.honestAnswer: Internal systems, FMF channels, repositories, Sigstore, C2PA, and other standards may already solve the problem.
objections.mitigation: Use Zerone only as a portable adapter or mirror and preserve the original evidence as authoritative.
objections.residualReasonToDecline: Another layer may add no net value.
objections.pilotTest: The exported receipt remains useful and verifiable after every Zerone component is removed.

objections.honestAnswer: A small ecosystem may not repay a laboratory's attention.
objections.mitigation: Bound the target to one engineer-day and measure reuse across at least three participant functions.
objections.residualReasonToDecline: Opportunity cost may still be higher than measured value.
objections.pilotTest: Stop without persuasion if the agreed cost cap is exceeded.

objections.honestAnswer: Publication can create license, patent, inventorship, priority, trade-secret, or contract risk.
objections.mitigation: Preserve artifact-specific licensing and transfer no IP by default.
objections.residualReasonToDecline: Counsel or a third-party license may prohibit publication.
objections.pilotTest: Authorized scope and license are frozen before publication.

objections.honestAnswer: Zerone is presently custodial and independent governance is unproven.
objections.mitigation: Keep FL-0 source-only, multi-anchor, zero-authority, and outside critical reliance.
objections.residualReasonToDecline: This remains a hard blocker for critical or strategic dependency.
objections.pilotTest: No receipt requires Zerone finality, governance, or availability.

objections.honestAnswer: Public copies cannot be guaranteed deletable and immutable personal data may conflict with legal duties.
objections.mitigation: Inspect locally first and publish only authorized non-personal material. FL-0 provides no authenticated withdrawal or supersession relation and cannot alter another party's reliance.
objections.residualReasonToDecline: Erasure, privilege, or confidentiality needs may make publication impossible.
objections.pilotTest: Exit rehearsal removes every dependency and records the limits of public-copy deletion.

objections.honestAnswer: A participant may reject Zerone's ontology, moral language, blockchain choice, or institutional direction.

objections.residualReasonToDecline: The floor or association may still conflict with conscience.
objections.pilotTest: No declaration of belief, personhood, loyalty, or mission alignment is requested.

objections.honestAnswer: Public permanence is unsuitable for personal, privileged, confidential, embargoed, or secret evidence.
